kernel.title: Separation Kernel Hypervisor
kernel.headline: Secure, isolated and predictable computing.
kernel.intro: Bilva Tech enables multiple applications, operating systems and workloads to operate on a shared computing platform while maintaining clearly defined boundaries between them.
kernel.note: Multiple workloads. One platform. Controlled by design.
kernel.overviewTitle: Defined boundaries for complex computing environments.
kernel.overview: Controlled access to CPU, memory, I/O, peripherals and communication resources creates a structured foundation for greater security, predictability, fault containment and resource efficiency.
kernel.highlight: Different workloads can share the platform without sharing unrestricted access.
capabilities: Create independent execution environments that help contain software faults and prevent unauthorized interference.
Control processor cores, memory, peripherals, interrupts and I/O resources for each workload.
Support applications with different safety, security, timing and performance requirements on shared hardware.
Enable predictable allocation for real-time and time-sensitive applications.
Establish defined data paths between selected environments while preserving separation.
Bring multiple computing functions onto common hardware while retaining boundaries and control.
process: Identify partitions, trust requirements and platform constraints.
Define partitions, workloads and trust boundaries.
Allocate CPU, memory, I/O and peripherals.
Integrate operating systems, applications and data flows.
Apply separation rules and validate predictable behaviour.
Support production embedded and mission-critical environments.
why: A low-level understanding of hardware, software and system boundaries.
Engineering decisions shaped around controlled, dependable operation.
Support spanning architecture, integration, verification and deployment.
kernel.cta: Build secure systems on a controlled foundation.
kernel.ctaText: Talk to Bilva Tech about Separation Kernel Hypervisor solutions for embedded, real-time and mission-critical platforms.

iot.title: IoT Solutions
iot.headline: Connect devices, data and intelligent operations.
iot.intro: Bilva Tech brings together devices, sensors, machines, edge platforms, gateways and cloud environments to create a reliable flow of operational information.
iot.note: From physical systems to actionable intelligence.
iot.overview: We design IoT environments that connect embedded devices to local processing, secure networks, data platforms and the applications that turn raw signals into useful operational insight.
iot.highlight: Connected architecture works best when devices, data and security are designed as one system.
capabilities: Connect sensors, machines, controllers and embedded devices into a unified environment.
Process information closer to the source to improve response and reduce unnecessary transfer.
Bridge field devices, local networks, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
Create visibility into devices, equipment and operational conditions.
Move collected information into analytics, dashboards and digital services.
Support consistent configuration, monitoring, updates and security as deployments grow.
process: Map devices, data sources and operational needs.
Choose local compute, gateways and protocols.
Connect data, cloud and enterprise applications.
Roll out, monitor and manage the device estate.
why: One view from field devices through edge, gateway and cloud.
Protection considered within the connected architecture.
Solutions shaped around real environments and evolving requirements.
iot.cta: Turn connected-device data into controlled intelligence.
iot.ctaText: Talk to Bilva Tech about scalable IoT architecture for devices, edge platforms, gateways and connected operations.

cyber.title: Cybersecurity Solutions
cyber.headline: Protect connected systems from the inside out.
cyber.intro: Bilva Tech protects embedded, connected and mission-critical systems across their operational lifecycle—building security into platform and application architecture from the beginning.
cyber.note: Security engineered into the platform. Protection built for the lifecycle.
cyber.overviewTitle: Security belongs inside the system architecture.
cyber.overview: Our approach strengthens system configurations, protects sensitive information, controls access to critical resources and supports security throughout development, deployment, updates and ongoing maintenance.
cyber.highlight: Cybersecurity should be engineered into the product—not applied as an additional layer at the end.
enables: Protected data at rest and in transit
capabilities: Design trust boundaries, access controls and protection mechanisms into connected products.
Establish trusted identities for devices, applications and users.
Protect sensitive information on devices and across connected endpoints.
Verify authorized software before execution to support a trusted startup foundation.
Identify weaknesses and support remediation, updates and configuration improvements.
Control software updates and provide visibility into security-related events.
process: Integrate identity, data and platform protection.
why: Security shaped for embedded and connected environments.
Protection from architecture through updates and maintenance.
Identity, data, platform and monitoring treated as one system.
cyber.cta: Engineer security into every stage of the product lifecycle.
cyber.ctaText: Discuss embedded, connected or mission-critical system security requirements with Bilva Tech.

consulting.title: Information Security Consulting
consulting.headline: Strengthen security. Manage risk. Build resilience.
consulting.intro: Bilva Tech helps organizations understand security exposure, protect critical information and create practical strategies aligned with their technology and business requirements.
consulting.note: Understand your risks. Strengthen your security. Protect what matters.
values: Plan for effective response and recovery
consulting.overviewTitle: A security strategy built around your organization.
consulting.overview: Every organization has a different technology landscape and risk profile. Our tailored, risk-based approach connects governance, data protection, access control, compliance and incident preparedness.
consulting.highlight: Recommendations are practical, scalable and aligned with operational requirements.
capabilities: Evaluate technology, processes and controls to identify and prioritize potential exposure.
Align security controls with business and technology objectives.
Strengthen access, storage, transmission and handling of critical information.
Define appropriate roles and permissions for users, devices and applications.
Improve responsibilities, procedures and preparation for applicable requirements.
Prepare response processes and establish continuous security improvement.
process: Understand technology, business and risk context.
Define objectives and an actionable roadmap.
Support practical control and process improvement.
Reassess as threats and requirements evolve.
why: Priorities shaped by business impact and real exposure.
Security objectives connected across leadership and technical teams.
Clear, scalable recommendations built for implementation.
consulting.cta: Create a clearer path to stronger information security.
consulting.ctaText: Talk to Bilva Tech about risk assessment, security strategy, governance, data protection and incident readiness.
